content: reqwest 0.13.5 (2026-09-08, MSRV 1.85): default features = default-tls(rustls w/ aws-lc-rs + rustls-platform-verifier), charset, http2, system-proxy. 'socks' feature is empty flag (SOCKS4/4a/5/5h via hyper-util). query/form now opt-in. rustls-no-provider uses CryptoProvider::get_default(). No per-request proxy API on RequestBuilder; Proxy is per-Client (Proxy::all/http/https/custom + basic_auth). Each ClientBuilder::build creates a new platform Verifier unless tls_backend_preconfigured(rustls::ClientConfig) is used; preconfigured path does not set ALPN (must set h2/http1.1 yourself). Methods: read_timeout, pool_max_idle_per_host, pool_idle_timeout, tcp_keepalive, connector_layer, tls_certs_only/merge.
